units.source_text: 他们一起松开了手，跳上矿车。

en.t: They let go together and jumped onto the mine cart.

units.source_text: 开始，矿车只是缓慢下滑，

en.t: At first, the mine cart only slid slowly downward,

units.source_text: 然后，速度越来越快，一下子就从轨道上滑了下去。

en.t: Then it went faster and faster, and in an instant slid down along the rails.

units.source_text: 沿途风景就像被一劈而二似地向两侧分开，在他们眼前迅速铺开。

en.t: The scenery along the way seemed to split apart to both sides as if cleaved in two, rapidly opening out before their eyes.

units.source_text: 晚风吹拂者脸颊，脚下矿车飞舞——良平觉得自己飘飘欲仙，开心极了。

en.t: The evening breeze brushed their cheeks, and the mine cart seemed to fly beneath their feet; Ryohei felt as if he were floating in bliss and was utterly delighted.
